ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 / OceanLotus DLL side-loading via renamed signed binary in user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's hallmark DLL search-order hijack: dropping a legitimately-signed third-party EXE (Symantec RasTls, Google Update, McAfee, Notepad++ GUP, Aliwallet, etc.) into %AppData%/%Temp%/%ProgramData%/%Public% next to a malicious same-named DLL so the signed loader sideloads the implant (Denis, KOMPROGO, SOUNDBITE, METALJACK, Cobalt Strike). Documented across ESET, Volexity and Cybereason 'Cobalt Kitty' reporting on Canvas Cyclone/BISMUTH.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rastls.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","vmnat.exe","loadoa.exe","aliwallet.exe","wsetup.exe","gup.exe","mscorsvw.exe","acrord32.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*") AND NOT (Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Update\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\OneDrive\\*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host process_path max=0 [ | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rex field=file_path "(?<process_path>.+\\\\)[^\\\\]+$" | stats values(file_name) as sideloaded_dlls by host process_path ] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT32 signed-binary sideload hosts dropped to user-writable folders
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["rastls.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","vmnat.exe","loadoa.exe","aliwallet.exe","wsetup.exe","gup.exe","mscorsvw.exe","acrord32.exe"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\appdata\", @"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\temp\"]);
let LegitGoogleUpdate = @"\appdata\local\google\update\";
let LegitOneDrive = @"\appdata\local\microsoft\onedrive\";
let SignedHosts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | extend fp = tolower(FolderPath)
    | where fp has_any (UserWritable)
    | where not(fp has LegitGoogleUpdate) and not(fp has LegitOneDrive)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SignedExe = FileName, ExeFolder = FolderPath,
              ExeCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ExeSHA256 = SHA256,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let SiblingDlls = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | extend ExeFolder = FolderPath
    | project DllTimestamp = Timestamp, DeviceId, ExeFolder,
              SideloadedDll = FileName, DllSHA256 = SHA256,
              DllWriter = InitiatingProcessFileName;
SignedHosts
| join kind=inner SiblingDlls on DeviceId, ExeFolder
| where DllTimestamp between (Timestamp - 1h .. Timestamp + 5m)  // DLL planted just before / co-resident with the EXE launch
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), SideloadedDlls = make_set(SideloadedDll, 10),
            DllWriters = make_set(DllWriter, 5)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, SignedExe, ExeFolder, Parent, ParentCmd, ExeSHA256
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Same detection ported to Sentinel via the MDE connector tables
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["rastls.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","vmnat.exe","loadoa.exe","aliwallet.exe","wsetup.exe","gup.exe","mscorsvw.exe","acrord32.exe"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\appdata\", @"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\temp\"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where TargetProcessName in~ (SideloadHosts) or ActingProcessName in~ (SideloadHosts)
| extend fp = tolower(coalesce(ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessCommandLine))
| where fp has_any (UserWritable)
| where not(fp has @"\appdata\local\google\update\") and not(fp has @"\appdata\local\microsoft\onedrive\")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner (
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where TargetFileExtension =~ "dll"
    | project DllTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DllPath = TargetFilePath, SideloadedDll = TargetFileName, DllSHA256 = TargetFileSHA256
  ) on DvcHostname
| where DllTime between (TimeGenerated - 1h .. TimeGenerated + 5m)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), SideloadedDlls = make_set(SideloadedDll, 10)
          by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, SignedExe = TargetProcessName, ParentImage = ParentProcessName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Renamed Signed Binary Executed From User-Writable Path
id: 8c1f6a40-4d6d-4f3e-9b5a-apt32sideload01
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects APT32/OceanLotus DLL side-loading hosts – legitimately signed third-party
  binaries (Symantec RasTls, Google Update, McAfee, VMware vmnat, Notepad++ gup,
  Aliwallet, etc.) dropped to %AppData%/%ProgramData%/%Public%/%Temp% to load a
  malicious sibling DLL (Cobalt Kitty / Cobalt Strike beacon, KOMPROGO, METALJACK).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1574/002/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2018/03/13/oceanlotus-ships-new-backdoor/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\RasTls.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\vmnat.exe'
      - '\loadoa.exe'
      - '\aliwallet.exe'
      - '\wsetup.exe'
      - '\gup.exe'
      - '\mscorsvw.exe'
      - '\AcroRd32.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Temp\'
  filter_googleupdate:
    Image|contains: '\AppData\Local\Google\Update\'
  filter_onedrive:
    Image|contains: '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\OneDrive\'
  condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Portable/Notepad++ self-update flows (gup.exe) launched from a portable install in user space
  - Legacy in-house deployments that stage signed third-party tools under ProgramData
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\AppData\\* OR *\\appdata\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\users\\public\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\temp\\*) @Image:(*\\RasTls.exe OR *\\rastls.exe OR *\\goopdate.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\vmnat.exe OR *\\loadoa.exe OR *\\aliwallet.exe OR *\\wsetup.exe OR *\\gup.exe OR *\\GUP.exe OR *\\mscorsvw.exe OR *\\AcroRd32.exe OR *\\acrord32.exe) -@Image:*\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Update\\* -@Image:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\OneDrive\\*
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(RasTls|goopdate|GoogleUpdate|mcoemcpy|wsc_proxy|vmnat|loadoa|aliwallet|wsetup|gup|mscorsvw|AcroRd32)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(AppData|ProgramData|Temp|Users\\\\Public)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT (ImageFileName=/\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Update\\/i)
| NOT (ImageFileName=/\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\OneDrive\\/i)
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | TargetFileName=/\.dll$/i}, field=[aid], include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], mode=left)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), collect([TargetFileName], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: Bundle of binary names is APT32-specific tradecraft - RasTls.exe (Symantec sideload, OceanLotus original Denis dropper), goopdate/GoogleUpdate.exe (multiple OceanLotus 2018-2022 campaigns), wsc_proxy.exe (Avast sideload from PhantomNet), aliwallet.exe (Cobalt Kitty), vmnat.exe (Cybereason write-up). The combination 'signed third-party EXE + user-writable path + sibling DLL planted in same folder'
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 / OceanLotus Outlook WebView HomePage persistence (T1137.001)
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's well-documented persistence trick - writing an attacker-controlled URL into the Outlook 'WebView' homepage registry key (HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\<ver>\Outlook\WebView\{Inbox|Calendar|Tasks|Contacts}\URL). When Outlook opens the folder it fetches and renders the URL inside an embedded WebBrowser control, executing any HTA/JScript hosted on the C2. Volexity and ESET attributed this to OceanLotus/Canvas Cyclone targeting Vietnamese diaspora, ASEAN govt and human-rights orgs.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\*" OR Registry.registry_key_name="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\*") AND Registry.registry_value_name IN ("URL","URLBar","Homepage") AND (Registry.registry_value_data="http://*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="https://*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="file:*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="\\\\*") by host Registry.user Registry.registry_key_name Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name Registry.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT32 Outlook HomePage / WebView persistence
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| extend rk = tolower(RegistryKey)
| where rk matches regex @"\\software\\microsoft\\office\\\d+\.\d+\\outlook\\webview\\(inbox|calendar|tasks|contacts|notes|drafts|journal)"
| where RegistryValueName in~ ("URL","URLBar","Homepage")
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| extend rv = tolower(RegistryValueData)
| where rv startswith "http://" or rv startswith "https://" or rv startswith "file:" or rv startswith @"\\"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
// Exclude Outlook itself re-rendering a previously set value
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("outlook.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          WriterImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated","RegistryValueModified")
| extend rk = tolower(RegistryKey)
| where rk matches regex @"\\software\\microsoft\\office\\\d+\.\d+\\outlook\\webview\\(inbox|calendar|tasks|contacts|notes|drafts|journal)"
| where RegistryValue in~ ("URL","URLBar","Homepage")
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| extend rv = tolower(RegistryValueData)
| where rv startswith "http://" or rv startswith "https://" or rv startswith "file:" or rv startswith @"\\"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("outlook.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValue, RegistryValueData,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Outlook HomePage / WebView Persistence
id: apt32-outlook-webview-homepage-persistence
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects APT32/OceanLotus (Canvas Cyclone / BISMUTH / Cobalt Kitty) persistence
  via HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\<ver>\Outlook\WebView\{Inbox|Calendar|...}\URL.
  Outlook fetches and renders this URL inside an embedded WebBrowser control on
  folder open, executing any HTA / JScript / VBScript content hosted by the C2.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1137/
  - https://www.volexity.com/blog/2020/11/06/oceanlotus-extending-cyber-espionage-operations-through-fake-websites/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1137
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|re|i: '\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\\d+\.\d+\\Outlook\\WebView\\(Inbox|Calendar|Tasks|Contacts|Notes|Drafts|Journal)\\.*'
  selection_value:
    TargetObject|endswith:
      - '\URL'
      - '\URLBar'
      - '\Homepage'
  selection_data:
    Details|startswith:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'file:'
      - '\\'
  filter_outlook:
    Image|endswith: '\outlook.exe'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_outlook
falsepositives:
  - Legacy enterprise customisation of Outlook home page via GPO (rare in modern tenants; usually written by GPO machinery, not user processes)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\* OR *\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\*) @TargetObject:(*\\URL OR *\\URLBar OR *\\Homepage) @Details:(http* OR https* OR file:* OR \\\\*) -@Image:(*\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| RegObjectName=/\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\\d+\.\d+\\Outlook\\WebView\\(Inbox|Calendar|Tasks|Contacts|Notes|Drafts|Journal)\\/i
| RegValueName=/^(URL|URLBar|Homepage)$/i
| regex("^(http://|https://|file:|\\\\\\\\)", field=RegStringValue)
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\outlook\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp)])
ucs.rationale: The Outlook WebView HomePage URL registry path is a niche persistence mechanism, never used by modern legitimate software, and was repeatedly observed in OceanLotus campaigns (Volexity, ESET, Cybereason) against Vietnamese diaspora and ASEAN diplomatic targets. Any write of an http:/https:/file: URL into HKCU\...\Outlook\WebView\<folder>\URL by a non-outlook.exe writer in a user-context account is
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID
